title: Utility Order for Claiborne Electric Cooperative, Inc., ex parte. — Order No. U-37859 accepts the Joint Report and issues the Draft Order filed into the record on August 31, 2026, thereby recognizing no change in rates resulting from Claiborne’s Formula Rate Plan Annual Report Filing for the test year ending December 31, 2025. The vote occurred at the Commission’s September 16, 2026 Business and Executive Session.

documents.text:
LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
                                  ORDER NUMBER U-37859

              CLAIBORNE ELECTRIC COOPERATIVE, INC., EX PARTE.

Docket No. U-37859, In re: Formula Rate Plan Annual Report for test year ending December
31, 2025.

             (Decided at the September 16, 2026 Business and Executive Session.)


                                             ORDER

Overview and Procedural History

       The Louisiana Public Service Commission (“Commission”), having reviewed and

considered the Joint Report and Draft Order on Claiborne Electric Cooperative, Inc.’s Formula

Rate Plan Annual Report Filing for the Test Year Ending December 31, 2025 (“Joint Report”),

submitted by the Louisiana Public Service Commission Staff (“Staff”) and Claiborne Electric

Cooperative, Inc. (“CEC” or “Cooperative”), finds the Joint Report, together with its attached

exhibits, to be acceptable and in accordance with the provisions of the Commission’s Order No. U-

36552 dated February 19, 2024, as amended by Order No. U-36552-A dated April 26, 2024, which

established the Cooperative’s current Formula Rate Plan (“FRP”) for test years 2023-2025. The

Joint Report was filed into the record on August 31, 2026.

       The Joint Report indicated that, after adjustments, CEC earned a Modified Debt Service

Coverage Ratio (“MDSC”) of 1.82. Since CEC’s MDSC fell within the bandwidth prescribed in

the Cooperative’s FRP, no change in rates is required.

Commission Jurisdiction and Authority
       The Commission exercises jurisdiction over public utilities in Louisiana pursuant to Article

4, Section 21(B) of the Constitution of the State of Louisiana, which provides the following:

               The commission shall regulate all common carriers and public
               utilities and have such other regulatory authority as provided by law.
               It shall adopt and enforce reasonable rules, regulations, and
               procedures necessary for the discharge of its duties, and shall have
               other powers and perform other duties as provided by law.

       Pursuant to its constitutional authority, the Commission issued Orders Nos. U-36552 and

U-36552-A, which established CEC’s current FRP. The Cooperative’s FRP provides for a MDSC

bandwidth with a lower endpoint of 1.75, an upper endpoint of 1.95, and a midpoint of 1.85. Under

the FRP, if a test year’s MDSC is less than 1.75 or greater than 1.95, CEC’s FRP Rider revenue is

to be increased or decreased, respectively, by the amount necessary to increase or decrease the

MDSC to reach the midpoint of 1.85.
                                                                               Order No. U-37859
                                                                                          Page 1
 Commission Consideration
       This matter was considered at the Commission’s September 16, 2026 Business and

Executive Session. On motion of Chairman Skrmetta, seconded by Commissioner Campbell, and

unanimously adopted, the Commission voted to accept the Joint Report and issue the Draft Order

filed into the record on August 31, 2026.



THEREFORE, IT IS ORDERED THAT:
   1. The Commission accepts the Joint Report filed on August 31, 2026.


This order is effective immediately.

BY ORDER OF THE COMMISSION
BATON ROUGE, LOUISIANA
October 14, 2026
